---
title: "Wronskian Flowchart"
format: html
---

<style>
.flow-container-redesign {
  position: relative;
  height: 400px;
  width: 100%;
  background-color: #fefefe;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  justify-items: center;
  font-family: sans-serif;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
}

.node-redesign {
  padding: 15px 25px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  min-width: 180px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  transition: transform 0.2s;
  position: relative;
}

.node-redesign:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
}

.start-redesign {
  background: #e3f2fd;
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
  grid-column: 2 / 3;
  grid-row: 1 / 2;
}

.decision-redesign {
  background: #fff8e1;
  border: 2px solid #ff9800;
  grid-column: 2 / 3;
  grid-row: 2 / 3;
  padding: 20px 30px;
}

.result-yes {
  background: #e3f2fd;
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
  grid-column: 1 / 2;
  grid-row: 2 / 3;
}

.result-no {
   background: #e3f2fd;
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
  grid-column: 3 / 4;
  grid-row: 2 / 3;
}
</style>

<div class="flow-container-redesign">
  <div id="start-redesign" class="node-redesign start-redesign">
    Start
  </div>
  <div id="check-redesign" class="node-redesign decision-redesign">
    Check Wronskian W(F₁, F₂, ..., Fₙ)
  </div>
  <div id="dep-redesign" class="node-redesign result-yes">
    = 0 Linearly Dependent
  </div>
  <div id="indep-redesign" class="node-redesign result-no">
    ≠ 0 Linearly Independent
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('start-redesign'),
      document.getElementById('check-redesign'),
      {
        startPlug: 'disc',
        endPlug: 'arrow1',
        size: 2,
        color: '#1976d2',
        path: 'straight',
        startSocket: 'bottom',
        endSocket: 'top'
      }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('check-redesign'),
      document.getElementById('dep-redesign'),
      {
        startPlug: 'disc',
        endPlug: 'arrow1',
        size: 2,
        color: '#e91e63',
        path: 'arc',
        startSocket: 'left',
        endSocket: 'top'
      }
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('check-redesign'),
      document.getElementById('indep-redesign'),
      {
        startPlug: 'disc',
        endPlug: 'arrow1',
        size: 2,
        color: '#4caf50',
        path: 'arc',
        startSocket: 'right',
        endSocket: 'top'
      }
    );
  });
</script>
